records.notes: HelioFITS is now HelioFITS Peek, with a new icon. A header drawer in Quick Look; RHEF, MGN and WOW filters with a swipe to compare; Compare two files by helioprojective coordinates; movie mode for a folder of FITS files; saved PNGs that record how they were made.

A Movie, Grid and List switch for a folder's FITS files, with a sortable table you can export as CSV; Get Info and Spotlight metadata in the Mac App Store build; a Colorbar button; faster folder movies; PUNCH units read as a multiplier.
